features.title: A strong foundation you can count on
features.text: Built with a solid pinewood back frame, our sofa offers a durable, warp-resistant structure that stands the test of time—giving your comfort a reliable base day after day.

features.title: Suspension that moves with you
features.text: The integrated S-spring system absorbs pressure evenly and adds a soft bounce, ensuring the seat always feels responsive, supported, and never stiff.

features.title: Comfort layered with care
features.text: Dual-density foam in the backrest gives you plush softness and deep support in all the right places—cradling your back and encouraging healthy posture.

features.title: Fabric that fits your lifestyle
features.text: Our anti-stain polyester fabric resists spills and marks, making it perfect for everyday living. It’s easy to clean and designed to keep your sofa looking fresh for years to come.

features.title: Lifted to lighten your space
features.text: Our sofa stands on high-impact, durable legs that do more than support—they elevate. The added height makes cleaning underneath easy, while giving your room an airy, open feel. It’s functional design that keeps your home looking and feeling effortlessly put together.
